priorityList: Trinket Usage We generally want to use stat-granting on-use trinkets with Trueshot.
Cast Black Arrow whenever available. Since Rapid Fire guarantees a proc, anticipate casting Black Arrow immediately after every Rapid Fire.
Cast Arcane Shot to consume Precise Shots stacks from Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire. Generally, you should follow every Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire with Arcane Shot.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler. Do not neglect the importance of filling every "empty" moment with these, as they generate a lot of Focus and Aimed Shot cooldown reduction.
Spend every Precise Shots proc on Arcane Shot on single-target
Follow up every Aimed Shot with an Arcane Shot
Follow up every Rapid Fire with an Arcane Shot
